overview_description.description: Tech Backpack is a media technology startup that developed an all-in-one social newsroom and digital storytelling platform for journalists, reporters, and media organizations. Founded in 2012, the platform was designed to simplify the news production workflow by combining social media monitoring, content discovery, source management, publishing, analytics, and newsroom collaboration tools into a single system.
